interactionClasses.structuralCondition: Neither participant has the full channel; A and B contribute complementary endpoint Gates so the full channel exists only in the relationship field.

customerFrame.zhHans: 这条完整连接不是任何一方单独拥有，而是在两人的已确认结构相遇时才出现。它值得作为“只有一起时更明显吗”的观察目标，而不是吸引力或命定关系证明。
customerFrame.en: This full connection is not individually owned by either participant; it appears only when the two confirmed structures meet. Treat it as something to observe together, not as proof of attraction or destiny.

interactionClasses.structuralCondition: One participant carries the full channel and the other carries neither endpoint Gate.

customerFrame.zhHans: 这条完整连接由一方稳定带入互动，另一方没有同一通道的端点结构。这里描述的是结构来源的不对称，不代表谁更强、谁必须服从。
customerFrame.en: One participant consistently brings this full connection while the other carries neither endpoint. This describes asymmetric structural ownership, not superiority or a requirement to submit.

interactionClasses.structuralCondition: One participant carries the full channel while the other carries exactly one of its endpoint Gates.

customerFrame.zhHans: 一方拥有完整通道，另一方与其中一个闸门有直接重叠。这里可能出现调整压力或“同一主题却不是同一完整结构”的体验；不把技术名词“妥协”写成关系指令。
customerFrame.en: One participant owns the full channel while the other overlaps through one endpoint Gate. This can create adjustment pressure around the same theme without implying that anyone must compromise or yield.

interactionClasses.structuralCondition: Both participants share the same full channel, or share the same Gate where no higher-priority Channel relation owns the evidence.

customerFrame.zhHans: 双方都带有同一结构证据，因此这个主题可能较容易彼此辨认或熟悉；共享结构不等于相同表达，也不等于更适配。
customerFrame.en: Both participants carry the same structural evidence, so the theme may feel easier to recognize in each other. Shared structure does not imply identical expression or greater compatibility.
